2 - Your profile is saying your native language is English, but that clearly seems to not be the case:

3 - None of us can change anything on the MogHunter Web site. Why isn't this an e-mail to him, asking for the correct link?
4 - RPG Maker VX and VX Ace don't use plugins, you can install scripts.
